summary: Jupiter aspecting the lagna gives religious and virtuous habits, honour from authorities, fame and good company, and protects and fills out the body; it is one of the strongest supports a lagna can have.
common_outcomes: interest in religious observances, honoured by rulers, famous, keeps the company of the virtuous, elders and guests (Saravali 34.1-7)
the lagna is strong when aspected by Jupiter, Mercury or its lord (Phaladeepika 4.6)
stout body if Jupiter aspects the lagna from a watery sign (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4)
fair complexion, large eyes and dignified bearing; tendency to corpulence (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
rare_outcomes: Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon as second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives Jupiter's aspect on the Moon as kingly status in Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn and Pisces; respect in Taurus; learning in Gemini; wisdom in Cancer; wealth in Leo; command of an army in Virgo; goldsmith's work in Libra; rule in Sagittarius; leadership in Aquarius. Raman HPA ch. XIII: the Jupiter-Moon opposition is extremely good.

Saturn, Mars and Venus in the lagna without Jupiter's aspect, with a waning Moon in the 7th: [maraka: text predicts the child's death in the 7th year] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII) - Jupiter's aspect is the protective factor.
Jupiter aspecting the lagna and Mercury trinally gave an analytical, legal intellect in a Raman case (HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).

by_area.health: Good constitution and fuller build (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).

strengtheners: Saravali 34.8: Sagittarius or Pisces lagna aspected by its own lord gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Phaladeepika 4.11: Jupiter is the most powerful planet for warding off evil.
Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4: aspect from a watery sign adds bodily stoutness.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter vitiated by association with Ketu or Rahu gives less benefit (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 6 chart notes).
lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 1 fully from the 7th (7th aspect), the 9th (5th aspect) and the 5th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

summary: Jupiter, the significator of wealth, aspecting the 2nd makes earnings good even against afflictions there, and his aspect on the 2nd from the Moon brings plenty of wealth.
common_outcomes: if Jupiter aspects the 2nd, earnings will be good, with money through friends and business (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5, under Rahu in the 2nd)
exalted Jupiter aspecting the 2nd makes the house very strong (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5, chart notes)
the 2nd from the Moon aspected by Venus or another benefic such as Jupiter: plenty of wealth (Saravali 34.15-20)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: earned wealth is lost (Saravali 34.15-20) - Mercury's aspect on Jupiter, recorded under aspect/mercury/2.

summary: Jupiter aspecting the 12th turns expenditure towards charity, service and spiritual life, and in Raman's cases supports selfless philanthropy and married comfort.
common_outcomes: benefic Jupiter aspecting the 12th made a selfless worker whose philanthropy helped many (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart)
Jupiter and Saturn aspecting the 12th in the chart of a missionary (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart)
the 12th and its lord with and aspected by benefics: moving within one's own country (BPHS 23.12)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter's aspect gave conjugal life until the native renounced it (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
12th lord aspected by Jupiter with the 9th lord in the 4th and the 10th lord in a kendra: a charitable disposition (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI) - aspect on the lord.
Benefic in the 12th with its lord exalted, or with or aspected by a benefic: final emancipation (BPHS 23.10).

by_area.finance: Spending on good causes (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).
by_area.relationships: Comfort in married life (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
by_area.spirituality: Charity, service, spiritual practice, moksha indications (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI; BPHS 23.10).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars's aspect on Jupiter in the 12th spoils its wealth-saving effect (Saravali 34.69-70).
lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 12 fully from the 6th (7th aspect), the 8th (5th aspect) and the 4th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.view: Benefic Jupiter aspecting the 12th made a selfless philanthropist; Jupiter's aspect gave conjugal life; Jupiter and Saturn aspecting the 12th in a missionary's chart; 12th lord aspected by Jupiter with other factors gives charity.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 23.10-12
source_views.view: Benefic in the 12th with its lord exalted or aspected by a benefic: emancipation; 12th and its lord with and aspected by benefics: moving within one's own country.

source_views.view: Jupiter in the 12th increases wealth if Mars does not aspect him.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 4.11
source_views.view: In completely warding off evil and promoting prosperity Jupiter is the most powerful planet; Mercury and Venus have smaller shares of that power (fractions illegible in the scan).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Jupiter aspects the 5th and 9th besides the 7th; results vary with the dignities of aspecting and aspected planets, but Jupiter's aspect as a natural benefic is weighty even when he is temporarily ill-disposed.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

disagreements: Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
phrasing_guidance: Describe Jupiter's aspect as protection, growth, wisdom and blessing on that house; keep it hopeful but not a guarantee.
